programme.desc: S01 E01 — Summer of the Saucers In the summer of 1952, stories of U.S. Air Force jets chasing UFOs over the White House knock the Korean War off the front pages of newspapers; as rumors spread, President Harry S. Truman demands to know what was flying over his house.
programme.title: Alien Files Reopened

programme.desc: S01 E02 — The Tall Whites A young recruit encounters aliens in the Nevada desert in the 1960s; he claims they were working with the US military and housed a spaceship in a secret hangar nearby.
programme.title: Alien Files Reopened

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Billy Meir, The Plejaren and the Multiverse Billy Meier claims he's traveled through time and space with an alien race from the Pleiades star cluster; in the decades following his revelation, both skeptics and ufologists say it's a hoax despite Meier providing photographic evidence.
programme.title: Alien Files Reopened

programme.desc: Separate fact from fiction with scientist Dr. David Hall, UFO expert Phillip Mantle, and ufologist Anna Whitty; dig into eyewitness accounts, meet a magician who shows what isn't an illusion in an alien autopsy film, and tackle conspiracy theories.
programme.title: Roswell 75: The Final Evidence

programme.desc: S01 E02 — Alien Invasion In July 1947, visitors to the south of Roswell described stumbling upon a crashed UFO; some witnesses even claim to have seen the bodies of aliens; their historic testimony has been dismissed for decades.
programme.title: Roswell: The Final Verdict

programme.desc: S01 E01 Meet a UK mother and son whose house was threatened by a glowing, intelligent orb; encounter ominous blue entities surrounding a young woman's bedroom in Wiltshire; see how an Australian camper shot his way out of an attempted alien abduction.
programme.title: We Are Not Alone

programme.desc: S01 E02 Reliving a UK law enforcement officer's haunting childhood close encounter, then getting spooked by a New Jersey mom's video of a UFO hovering in the sky; examining physical evidence from a scary extraterrestrial.
programme.title: We Are Not Alone

programme.desc: S01 E03 Checking out clues left behind by a Yorkshire man's alien encounter; reviewing photos of a UFO crash site in Australia; meeting a Canadian man whose voice was controlled by unknown forces.
programme.title: We Are Not Alone

programme.desc: S04 E20 — Death Valley UFO and More Two friends are chased out of California's Death Valley by a UFO; a ghostly hand reaches out to a woman in Wales; a webcam in the Scottish Highlands captures incredible evidence of the Loch Ness monster.
programme.title: Paranormal Caught on Camera

programme.desc: S04 E10 — Minnesota UFOs and More A woman in Tennessee is terrified to discover she is not alone while working from home; a ghoulish creature creeps up behind a group of friends in Indonesia; a Minnesota man seeks answers about a UFO sighting near his house.
programme.title: Paranormal Caught on Camera

programme.desc: S04 E07 — Bio UFO and More A shadow figure lurks in the halls of an abandoned asylum; UFO enthusiasts get the sighting of a lifetime in Southern California; a guardian angel saves a man from a horrific accident.
programme.title: Paranormal Caught on Camera

programme.desc: S04 E04 — Bronx UFO and More UFOs fly high above a neighborhood in the Bronx; spirit of a 3,000-year-old mummy in a British museum; Skunk Ape in Florida.

programme.title: Alien Files Reopened

programme.desc: S01 E02 — Alien Abduction and Reincarnation Experts investigate the 1961 alien abduction of Betty and Barney Hill; they explore past life regression and the possibilities of reincarnation.
programme.title: World's Most Unexplained

programme.title: World's Most Unexplained

programme.title: World's Most Unexplained

programme.title: World's Most Unexplained

programme.title: Mysteries From Above
